A project with no efficiency.station_budgets or default_station_budget therefore skips the completeness precondition. The owner must either amend R4 or authorize updates to the 22 protected tests. Until then, the conflict between R4 and the protected-test guardrail is unresolved.

Resolved from the loopback: the S4 missing-builder-report gap now has dedicated tests. tests/test_station_budgets_completeness.py test_s4_missing_report_alone_blocks_review_when_checks_pass runs a builder that changed a file, with checks passing and the report missing or empty. test_s4_completeness_gaps_names_a_missing_or_empty_report checks the None, empty and whitespace report cases against a passing control. These tests close the mutation gap where the report check was replaced with 'if False:'.
